verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST API, webhooks, and a JavaScript embed library. The embed library only places scheduling links on a website, so it is an adjacent feature rather than an official SDK or client library for building against the API. No official language SDKs appear in the evidence, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404, so there is no published spec to generate clients from.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
